warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Tdi Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The 200Tdi or 300Tdi is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older 200Tdi or 300Tdi V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every 200Tdi or 300Tdi rebuild.
Because the Discovery Tdi uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Discovery 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established 200Tdi or 300Tdi specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
